commit.message:
Recover unsettled external credits after corroborated fee and balance updates

Retain provisional external credits through lagged position observations. Restore their protected quantity only after attributable fee evidence and sufficient catch-up balance, preserving established owned entitlements and restart recovery.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Scope persisted trade identity to venue and event time

Preserve originals while accepting provider IDs reused on another day or venue. Add bounded concurrent-index migration, atomic conflict-aware generic writes, cross-session regressions and a private rollback-only PostgreSQL fixture. No historical backfill or trading-risk changes.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Wait for a safe notifier delivery-lease handoff

Allow the daily-only command to wait without dispatching or altering the current owner's heartbeat. Keep a notifier-only maintenance lease during the suspended Render service transition, and use the injected clock consistently for lease acquisition.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Commit ownership projections atomically and retain acknowledged recovery credits

Bound foreign inventory adoption by observed external-flow capacity while owned credits remain. Recover unsettled credits when attributed fees and aggregate positions corroborate them, including corrections to provisional closures. Keep cycle changes, activity checkpoints and audits in one transaction with version checks.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
